description: The designer's pull calculation on a route of straights and bends (a conduit or rollers): the tension out of each segment pulled from either end, the sidewall bearing pressure at each bend, the jam ratio, clearance and fill, against the allowable tension and pressure with their sources (makers' and utilities' pulling rules), and the governing limit. Without full and without payment the answer is the verdict a visitor sees on the site, counted against the designs' daily free allowance; full: true (or any paid call) answers in full. pdf: true adds the calculation sheet. input: {route: [{kind: "straight", length (m), slope (deg)} | {kind: "bend", radius (m), angle (deg), plane: "h" | "v"}] (1 to 40), n (cables, 1 to 12), arrangement: auto | triplex | cradled, duct: {kind: "conduit", material: steel | pvc | fibre | asbestos, idMm} | {kind: "conduit", material, raceway: "EMT", metric: 53} | {kind: "rollers"}, head: eye | grip, feedN?, mu?, jacket?, limitN?, swbpNPerM?}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; the free verdict counts against the designs' 2 free calls per caller per UTC day; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.
